text:
Email thread "Alpha Lexington" (Gmail thread 1a0d4b73ef31138e). Message bodies verbatim (typographic quotes normalised to straight); salutations and signatures omitted.

From: Robbie Forrest <robbie.forrest@trilogy.com>, VP of Operations - Education, Trilogy
Date: 2026-10-05 16:04 PT; cc J.C. Fischer, Artemis Fletcher

One final cleanup on the Lexington page <https://alpha.school/boston-suburbs/>: delete the standalone sentence "We will update this page if and when the School Committee takes action."

Keep the existing sentence beginning "Alpha welcomes inquiries from interested families" as its own paragraph, with the inquiries link. It already includes the update language.

Please confirm once that is published.

From: Robbie Forrest
Date: 2026-10-05 23:10 PT; cc J.C. Fischer, Artemis Fletcher

Tad still saw the duplicate update sentence after your confirmation. Please purge the host and Cloudflare caches for the Lexington page <https://alpha.school/boston-suburbs/> this morning before his call, then confirm the purge time and verify the public page in a fresh browser session.

Please also check the search/share descriptions (meta, Open Graph and Twitter) and the Lexington card on Locations <https://alpha.school/locations/>. Align them with the existing approved status: proposed, under School Committee review, not open or enrolling. Use the existing inquiry link instead of the Lexington card's "Apply Now" link, and update the source that feeds nightly publishing so it stays corrected.

From: Matt Barge (reply, 2026-10-06 08:40 PT), excerpt
Search/share: meta, Open Graph, and Twitter descriptions now match the approved status (proposed, under School Committee review, not open or enrolling).
Locations: Lexington card now uses the inquiry / Stay In-the-Know path instead of Apply Now, with proposed-campus status. HubSpot application link cleared and the nightly Locations workflow republished so the inquiry button, status, and all three search/share descriptions stay aligned. Applied and verified at 8:29 AM PT / 10:29 AM Central.
